name: Tomb Furnishing in the Form of a Cash-box or Chest with Stylized Floral Decor
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；probably 9th century；Sancai ("three-color") ware: molded white earthenware with variegated, lead-fluxed clear, emerald-green, and caramel-brown glazes. Probably from kilns at Luoyang or Gongxian, Henan province.
